serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Goodbye…
He’s pretty fast on these wheels. He disappeared into another room after a few seconds. 
I learned a lot today, but I don’t think this was what I wanted. I have no use for this trivia bullshit. 
It’s time to go home I guess. I lost a lot of time being here and there’s nothing more to do.
Maybe I will come back later, but this is not my priority.
